description.en: Shows and resumes (true) or hides and pauses (false) parts of the field: it clears or sets the bits _offBit in both the draw-off bits and the pause bits, then waits one frame. By default it acts on the field characters and the field camera.
true to show and resume, false to hide and pause.

examples.case: Hiding the field before placing characters (real usage, from ev42010300.nut; the Shift-JIS motion name is replaced by a variable here)
